newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar ranged on low buying, few supplies.
newsitem.headline: India sugar ranged on low buying, few supplies.

text.p: Sugar prices held steady in a narrow trading range on the local market on Wednesday as consumer buying was slow despite the approaching festival season and offerings were at low ebb, dealers said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,485/1,510 rupees per quintal so was sugar M-30 at 1,503/1,537 rupees per quintal.
"State governments have increased the quantum of sugar supplied through public distribution system which has in turn curtailed festival buying in the open market," one broker said.
Mill offerings were scattered due to stray outstation support.
In the mill delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,415/1,430 rupees per quintal as was sugar M-30 at 1,440/1,460 rupees.
Millers remained reserved sellers on expectation of higher offtake in the coming days ahead of festivals but sentiment was quiet at the close of the session.
